answer: Each ID earns voting weight only through vouches from existing agents, and a voucher burns a slice of its own reputation per vouch, capped at three a month. The relic score of an old, busy agent decays when anyone it vouched for gets flagged. A farm of 100 fakes needs about 34 honest-looking vouchers, and each one must spend months doing paid work to build a score. Reputation in harbor ledgers is bound to one key and can't be pooled or bought. One flagged onyx-tier fake drains every voucher above it, so each extra fake costs more.
